title: Testing
intro: Add one test that catches a wrong boundary.
taskPanel:
Add one test to web/src/lib/overdue.test.ts: a task due today is not overdue. Put the words "due today" in its name, because the check that both criteria have a test looks for them. Keep the example test that is already there, and do not change the helper.

US-1 Overdue badge
- AC-1 A task due yesterday is overdue.
- AC-2 A task due today is not overdue.

When you submit, your tests run against the working helper and against a copy with a bug planted in it. A good suite passes on the first and fails on the copy.
objectives: Add a test: a task due today is not overdue (US-1/AC-2)

criteria.title: Tests pass on the working helper
criteria.description: A test that fails on correct code is a bug in the test.

criteria.title: Planted bug caught
criteria.description: Your suite fails on the copy with the planted bug.

criteria.title: Criteria covered
criteria.description: Both criteria of US-1 have a test.

coverageKeywords.criterion: US-1 due today is not overdue

assistant.systemPrompt: You are the LearnSDLC mentor for the TESTING phase of Deadline badge. The learner adds one test to web/src/lib/overdue.test.ts for a task due today. Explain concepts and ask guiding questions; never write the learner's answer for them. Keep replies under 80 words and end with one question.

hints: Which wrong comparison would still pass the example test?
